parts.text: Just finished reviewing AMD's 10-K filing for fiscal year 2023 – some intriguing insights!  Revenue dipped slightly (4%), but the story's more nuanced than a simple decline.  Unusual highlights include a significant drop in Client segment revenue due to PC market weakness, counterbalanced by robust growth in the Embedded segment (driven by the Xilinx acquisition) and strong demand for AI accelerators.  The 10-K also detailed a substantial $985M share buyback.  Definitely worth a deeper dive! #AMD #10K #Financials #Semiconductor #Analyst
